responsibility: Implements GIMPLE tail/block merging of equivalent basic blocks. It clusters blocks with identical operations under same-predecessor or same-successor conditions, rewires predecessors or successors and repairs PHIs, updates profile counts and debug statements, marks virtual operands for renaming after merges, and iterates until no more profitable whole-block merges remain, serving as tree-level cross-jumping/cfg deduplication support used after PRE and other simplifications.
